papers.title: Unified Representation Learning for Spatial Multi-Omics
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Integrating spatial multi-omics data is crucial for decoding tissue function, yet existing methods struggle with noise and cross-modal alignment. Results We introduce SpaAlign, a novel two-stage framework for the robust integration of multiple omics and histological data. At its core, a contrastive learning stage creates a unified semantic space, followed by a self-supervised clustering stage that enforces structural coherence. Our evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness in accurately delineating the capsule-cortex-medulla architecture in human lymph nodes and precisely identifying germinal centers in human tonsil data, outperforming baseline methods. Availability and Implementation The source code is available at https://github.com/VitaIntelli-CQU/SpaAlign . The source code is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20250508
papers.abstract:
MOTIVATION: Integrating spatial multi-omics data is crucial for decoding tissue function, yet existing methods struggle with noise and cross-modal alignment.

RESULTS: We introduce SpaAlign, a novel two-stage framework for the robust integration of multiple omics and histological data. At its core, a contrastive learning stage creates a unified semantic space, followed by a self-supervised clustering stage that enforces structural coherence. Our evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness in accurately delineating the capsule-cortex-medulla architecture in human lymph nodes and precisely identifying germinal centers in human tonsil data, outperforming baseline methods.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code is available at https://github.com/VitaIntelli-CQU/SpaAlign. The source code is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20250508.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 动机：整合空间多组学数据对于解析组织功能至关重要，然而现有方法在处理噪声问题以及实现跨模态数据对齐方面存在明显不足。
llm_highlights_zh: 结果：我们提出了SpaAlign这一新型的两阶段框架，该框架能够高效整合多种组学数据与组织学信息。
从本质上讲，对比学习阶段会构建一个统一的语义空间，随后通过自监督聚类过程来确保该语义空间的结构一致性。
我们的评估结果表明，该方法在准确描绘人类淋巴结中的囊状结构、皮质结构及髓质结构方面表现出显著效果，并能在人类扁桃体数据中精准识别生发中心，其性能明显优于现有的基准方法。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要与动机**  
整合空间多组学数据对于解析组织功能至关重要，但现有方法在处理噪声及跨模态对齐问题时存在明显不足。  

**研究结果**  
我们提出了SpaAlign这一新型两阶段框架，用于高效整合多种组学数据与组织学信息。该框架首先通过对比学习构建统一的语义空间，随后通过自监督聚类确保数据结构的一致性。实验结果表明，SpaAlign在准确描绘人类淋巴结中的“囊泡-皮质-髓质”结构以及精准识别人类扁桃体中的生发中心方面表现优异，其性能明显优于现有方法。  

**代码与应用**  
源代码可访问以下链接：https://github.com/VitaIntelli-CQU/SpaAlign；相关数据存档地址为：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20250508。

papers.title: SNPannotator: Automated Functional Annotation of Genetic Variants and Linked Proxies
papers.summary: Abstract Summary Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have identified thousands of genetic variants associated with complex traits and diseases. However, explaining the mechanisms underlying phenotypic variation remains challenging. Here, we introduce SNPannotator , an automated post-GWAS analysis software package designed to streamline the interpretation of GWAS findings. Our pipeline implements a multi-step process that identifies proxy variants in high linkage disequilibrium (LD) with associated lead variants, then queries comprehensive resources (including Ensembl, the GTEx Portal, the eQTL Catalog, and STRING DB) for genomic position, deleteriousness, regulatory annotations, clinical significance, trait associations, expression (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs), and functional enrichment analyses and compiles the results into user-friendly reports. This package is implemented in the R programming language and includes auxiliary functions for variant lookup and LD exploration. SNPannotator provides a practical framework for efficiently deriving biologically meaningful insights from GWAS data and for assisting researchers in prioritizing candidate variants for functional validation. Availability and implementation The SNPannotator package is available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SNPannotator . The development version and tutorial is available on GitHub ( https://github.com/omicslaboratory/SNPannotator ). The online version of the package is available at https://omicslab.org/snpannotator
papers.abstract:
SUMMARY: Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have identified thousands of genetic variants associated with complex traits and diseases. However, explaining the mechanisms underlying phenotypic variation remains challenging. Here, we introduce SNPannotator, an automated post-GWAS analysis software package designed to streamline the interpretation of GWAS findings. Our pipeline implements a multi-step process that identifies proxy variants in high linkage disequilibrium (LD) with associated lead variants, then queries comprehensive resources (including Ensembl, the GTEx Portal, the eQTL Catalog, and STRING DB) for genomic position, deleteriousness, regulatory annotations, clinical significance, trait associations, expression (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs), and functional enrichment analyses and compiles the results into user-friendly reports. This package is implemented in the R programming language and includes auxiliary functions for variant lookup and LD exploration. SNPannotator provides a practical framework for efficiently deriving biologically meaningful insights from GWAS data and for assisting researchers in prioritizing candidate variants for functional validation.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The SNPannotator package is available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SNPannotator. The development version and tutorial is available on GitHub (https://github.com/omicslaboratory/SNPannotator). The online version of the package is available at https://omicslab.org/snpannotator.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

papers.llm_title_zh: SNPannotator：遗传变异及其相关标记的自动化功能注释工具
papers.llm_title_bilingual: SNPannotator：遗传变异及其相关标记的自动化功能注释工具 / SNPannotator: Automated Functional Annotation of Genetic Variants and Linked Proxies
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：全基因组关联研究已发现了数千种与复杂性状及疾病相关的遗传变异。
llm_highlights_zh: 然而，要解释导致表型变异的机制仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。
在这里，我们向您介绍SNPannotator——这款专为简化GWAS研究结果解读而设计的自动化后续分析软件包。

我们的分析流程包括多个步骤：首先识别那些与关键变异株高度连锁不平衡的候选变异株，随后查询包括Ensembl、GTEx Portal、eQTL Catalog以及STRING DB在内的多种数据库，以获取这些候选变异株的基因组位置、致病性、调控功能信息、临床意义、与表型特征的相关性、表达水平数据（如eQTLs和sQTLs），并进行功能富集分析。最终，我们将所有分析结果整理成用户易于理解的报告形式呈现出来。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：全基因组关联研究已发现了数千种与复杂性状及疾病相关的遗传变异，但解释这些变异如何影响表型仍面临挑战。为此，我们开发了SNPannotator这一自动化后分析工具包，旨在简化GWAS结果的解读流程。该工具通过多步骤分析流程：首先识别那些与目标变异具有高度连锁不平衡关系的候选变异，随后查询包括Ensembl、GTEx Portal、eQTL Catalog及STRING DB在内的多种数据库，获取这些变异的基因组位置、致病性、调控功能、临床意义、性状关联信息以及表达谱数据等，并进行功能富集分析，最终将所有结果整理成用户友好的报告格式。该工具包采用R编程语言实现，同时还提供了用于查询遗传变异信息及分析连锁不平衡关系的辅助功能。SNPannotator为从GWAS数据中提取生物学意义丰富的信息、帮助研究人员确定值得进一步功能验证的候选变异提供了有效途径。

获取与使用：SNPannotator工具包可通过Comprehensive R Archive Network（CRAN）官网下载：https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SNPannotator。开发版本及使用教程可访问GitHub页面：https://github.com/omicslaboratory/SNPannotator。该工具的在线版本也可通过以下链接访问：https://omicslab.org/snpannotator

all_papers.title: Unified Representation Learning for Spatial Multi-Omics
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Integrating spatial multi-omics data is crucial for decoding tissue function, yet existing methods struggle with noise and cross-modal alignment. Results We introduce SpaAlign, a novel two-stage framework for the robust integration of multiple omics and histological data. At its core, a contrastive learning stage creates a unified semantic space, followed by a self-supervised clustering stage that enforces structural coherence. Our evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness in accurately delineating the capsule-cortex-medulla architecture in human lymph nodes and precisely identifying germinal centers in human tonsil data, outperforming baseline methods. Availability and Implementation The source code is available at https://github.com/VitaIntelli-CQU/SpaAlign . The source code is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20250508
all_papers.abstract:
MOTIVATION: Integrating spatial multi-omics data is crucial for decoding tissue function, yet existing methods struggle with noise and cross-modal alignment.

RESULTS: We introduce SpaAlign, a novel two-stage framework for the robust integration of multiple omics and histological data. At its core, a contrastive learning stage creates a unified semantic space, followed by a self-supervised clustering stage that enforces structural coherence. Our evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness in accurately delineating the capsule-cortex-medulla architecture in human lymph nodes and precisely identifying germinal centers in human tonsil data, outperforming baseline methods.

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 动机：整合空间多组学数据对于解析组织功能至关重要，然而现有方法在处理噪声问题以及实现跨模态数据对齐方面存在明显不足。
llm_highlights_zh: 结果：我们提出了SpaAlign这一新型的两阶段框架，该框架能够高效整合多种组学数据与组织学信息。
从本质上讲，对比学习阶段会构建一个统一的语义空间，随后通过自监督聚类过程来确保该语义空间的结构一致性。
我们的评估结果表明，该方法在准确描绘人类淋巴结中的囊状结构、皮质结构及髓质结构方面表现出显著效果，并能在人类扁桃体数据中精准识别生发中心，其性能明显优于现有的基准方法。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要与动机**  
整合空间多组学数据对于解析组织功能至关重要，但现有方法在处理噪声及跨模态对齐问题时存在明显不足。  

**研究结果**  
我们提出了SpaAlign这一新型两阶段框架，用于高效整合多种组学数据与组织学信息。该框架首先通过对比学习构建统一的语义空间，随后通过自监督聚类确保数据结构的一致性。实验结果表明，SpaAlign在准确描绘人类淋巴结中的“囊泡-皮质-髓质”结构以及精准识别人类扁桃体中的生发中心方面表现优异，其性能明显优于现有方法。

all_papers.title: SNPannotator: Automated Functional Annotation of Genetic Variants and Linked Proxies
all_papers.summary: Abstract Summary Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have identified thousands of genetic variants associated with complex traits and diseases. However, explaining the mechanisms underlying phenotypic variation remains challenging. Here, we introduce SNPannotator , an automated post-GWAS analysis software package designed to streamline the interpretation of GWAS findings. Our pipeline implements a multi-step process that identifies proxy variants in high linkage disequilibrium (LD) with associated lead variants, then queries comprehensive resources (including Ensembl, the GTEx Portal, the eQTL Catalog, and STRING DB) for genomic position, deleteriousness, regulatory annotations, clinical significance, trait associations, expression (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs), and functional enrichment analyses and compiles the results into user-friendly reports. This package is implemented in the R programming language and includes auxiliary functions for variant lookup and LD exploration. SNPannotator provides a practical framework for efficiently deriving biologically meaningful insights from GWAS data and for assisting researchers in prioritizing candidate variants for functional validation. Availability and implementation The SNPannotator package is available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SNPannotator . The development version and tutorial is available on GitHub ( https://github.com/omicslaboratory/SNPannotator ). The online version of the package is available at https://omicslab.org/snpannotator

However, explaining the mechanisms underlying phenotypic variation remains challenging. Here, we introduce SNPannotator, an automated post-GWAS analysis software package designed to streamline the interpretation of GWAS findings. Our pipeline implements a multi-step process that identifies proxy variants in high linkage disequilibrium (LD) with associated lead variants, then queries comprehensive resources (including Ensembl, the GTEx Portal, the eQTL Catalog, and STRING DB) for genomic position, deleteriousness, regulatory annotations, clinical significance, trait associations, expression (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs), and functional enrichment analyses and compiles the results into user-friendly reports. all_papers.primary_summary_raw:
SUMMARY: Genome-wide association studies (GWASs) have identified thousands of genetic variants associated with complex traits and diseases. However, explaining the mechanisms underlying phenotypic variation remains challenging. Here, we introduce SNPannotator, an automated post-GWAS analysis software package designed to streamline the interpretation of GWAS findings. Our pipeline implements a multi-step process that identifies proxy variants in high linkage disequilibrium (LD) with associated lead variants, then queries comprehensive resources (including Ensembl, the GTEx Portal, the eQTL Catalog, and STRING DB) for genomic position, deleteriousness, regulatory annotations, clinical significance, trait associations, expression (eQTLs) and splicing quantitative trait loci (sQTLs), and functional enrichment analyses and compiles the results into user-friendly reports. This package is implemented in the R programming language and includes auxiliary functions for variant lookup and LD exploration. SNPannotator provides a practical framework for efficiently deriving biologically meaningful insights from GWAS data and for assisting researchers in prioritizing candidate variants for functional validation.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The SNPannotator package is available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SNPannotator. The development version and tutorial is available on GitHub (https://github.com/omicslaboratory/SNPannotator). The online version of the package is available at https://omicslab.org/snpannotator.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

all_papers.title: Benchmark pitfalls expose need for expert-guided spatial clustering
all_papers.summary: Benchmarking computational tools for cutting-edge technologies such as spatially resolved transcriptomics is challenging owing to the lack of reproducibility, of data and of evaluation strategies that are faithful to multiscale spatial biology. However, we found that complementing computational consensus strategies with feedback from histology and cell biology experts circumvents these limitations to accelerate biological discovery
